triage.proposed_comment: This was fixed in commit e12441a3: posting to /admin/rules/ without an archetype_id now returns a 200 with a user-friendly error message ("Please select an archetype.") rather than a 500. A test covers the behavior.

verify.final_comment: Fixed in commit e12441a3: posting to /admin/rules/ without selecting an archetype now returns a user-friendly error page containing 'Please select an archetype.' instead of raising an InvalidArgumentException (500). A regression test at admin_test.py:77 covers this behavior.
